featureDiagnostics.method: Drop-one feature refits on chronological holdout; preprocessing refit inside each training fold. Permutation importance uses five holdout shuffles per feature.
featureDiagnostics.interpretation: Positive drop-one deltas mean removing the feature worsened the model; negative deltas mean removal improved it. Permutation increases measure predictive reliance, not causal importance. Correlated features can mask one another.
